In a toy store of a shopping center, salesperson Xiao Zhang is arranging various toys. He tells mom Liu, "We have 50 different toys, most of them are dolls, some are puzzles, but there are hardly any remote control cars." Liu checks and finds only 10 puzzle toys.

[Question]
After checking, how many dolls does Liu guess there are?

[Candidate Answers]
A. After checking, Liu guesses there are 40 dolls.
B. After checking, Liu guesses there are 50 dolls.
C. After checking, Liu guesses there are 45 dolls.
D. After checking, Liu guesses there are 35 dolls.
